EXISTING CODE TO READ FIRST:
CLAUDE.md; CODEX.md; ops/e2e-test-plan.md; ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml; openspec/capabilities/research-reporting/spec.md; openspec/capabilities/verification/spec.md; scripts/experiment_template.py; python/carnot/reporting/primary_publication.py; openspec/change-proposals/research-roadmap-vNEXT.md; python/carnot/reporting/brier_online_learning_8517.py; python/carnot/verify/capacity_online_learning_8434.py; python/carnot/verify/objective_derivatives_8461.py; results/experiment_8434_v726_capacity_online_learning.json; results/experiment_8516_v732_objective_publication_qualification.json; openspec/change-proposals/v732-methods-protocol.json
TASK:
Measure continuous delayed Brier learning with independent coordinate accounting. Deliver results/experiment_8531_v733_causal_brier_learning.json. Create thin runner scripts/experiments/experiment_8531_v733_causal_brier_learning.py, primitive evidence under results/raw/experiment_8531_v733_causal_brier_learning/, and docs/research-notes/v733-causal-brier-learning.md. Same-roadmap upstream outputs are future dependencies.
CONCRETE STEPS:
1. PRECONDITIONS: Print a flushed start line. Authenticate the current task, original input hashes, tools, free memory, writable disk-backed scratch and deadlines. Use original sealed dates and authority for historical inputs. Record exact missing inputs and observed values in gate_check_summary. CUDA and board absence must not block independent CPU work.
2. Print a flushed progress line at every phase boundary and before and after any model load, generation, benchmark or subprocess that can take minutes. Use unbuffered output and print completed/pending counts inside long loops. Supervise children with a status line at least every 60 seconds; keep every output gap under 600 seconds. Write any file over about 200 lines in several tool calls of at most about 150 lines, with a progress message between calls. Bound every tool call. Stop measurement by 3600 seconds and reserve at least 900 seconds for validation within the 4800-second hard cap. Never pad duration.
3. Spec first: ensure applicable REQ-* and SCENARIO-* exist before implementation. Write focused failing tests first. Preserve existing assertions, thresholds and historical source snapshots. Reuse shipped code through small explicit adapters. Keep runners in scripts/experiments/, tests in tests/python/, scratch outside the repository root. Accept --date {date}. Do not modify the active roadmap, conductor, validation gates, generator weights or external services.
4. Declare inference_substrate_class=no_model_load, MODEL_SPECS=[] and zero current LLM calls. Use aggregation_from_upstream_artifacts for readers or verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates for numerical heads. Cached generator outputs belong only in historical_model_provenance.
5. Authenticate Exp8530 exact terminal consumer and Exp8516 original qualification before reading feedback. Retain the original V726 full nine-input109-coefficient head in every arm, not Exp8528 fitted heads. Copy objective_updates numerical operands exactly; change only qualified reporting and test execution.
6. Run frozen,log_loss,brier,brier_shuffled_released on five blocks of20 questions, capacity8, seeds17/29/43/71/101. Produce6000 intended answer/seed/arm rows. Persist issued predictions and identical uniform admission IDs before label release. Apply only released admitted feedback once, with stable IDs,RNG,cursor and coefficient state. Preserve unadmitted,pending,lost,duplicate and released counts.
7. For seed17 in each arm, exit the actual child after block2 and resume. Require bit-identical final states and issued predictions versus uninterrupted execution. A separate read-only evaluator measures all five retention windows on original50 tune questions; labels never enter the learner. Shuffling uses only labels released by that step.
8. Record applied-update events, actual coordinate writes, before/after coordinate changes, logical decay effects, per-update compute, serialization/fsync/ack clocks, memory and pending high-water. Independently reduce these metrics through Exp8530 schema. No physical-update count can stand in for prediction benefit. Sparse CPU arithmetic is the present hardware path; GPU/NPU and FPGA need their own measured operations.
9. Keep full prediction/update primitives. Reuse valid same-invocation checkpoints for restart, but never promote old flagged scientific rows into new observations. Emit objective_stream_ready_score only after6000 stream slots,15000 retention slots,four restart comparisons and all current consumers qualify. A completed zero-benefit stream may still be ready; external missing qualification is blocked.
10. Run scoped unit tests, actual private CLI checks, Ruff check/format, strict mypy and scripts/check_spec_coverage.py --files <owned-test-files>. Run applicable ops/e2e-test-plan.md checks, including private E2E-018 and E2E-021 for authority/publication consumers. Require 100 percent newly owned statement coverage, including child and rejection paths. Collect original test node IDs first and preserve their exact union in disjoint bounded shards using pytest -n 0 -o addopts= --no-cov. Supervise each shard with heartbeats; record commands, exit codes, durations and log hashes. Do not launch a nested full historical validation runner or the full repository suite. A killed child is failed validation, not a skipped success.
11. Cold-replay primitive rows in a fresh bounded process; exercise absent inputs, owned failure and self-consistently rehashed tampering. Run unchanged primary_publication, scripts/adversarial_verify.py --json <private-candidate> and scripts/verdict_row_consistency_lint.py --strict <private-candidate>. Preserve every finding. Validate final bytes, publish atomically, bind the terminal sidecar, then exercise the actual downstream consumer. Historical flagged bytes and sidecars stay immutable. Owned validation failure is disqualified. Unchanged external absence is blocked, never partial. Reconcile openspec/, _bmad/traceability.md, ops/status.md and ops/changelog.md.
REQUIRED ARTIFACT FIELDS:
experiment_id, task_id, milestone, run_date: principle: Bind evidence to the actual invocation.
honest_verdict, verdict_class: principle: Terminal honest_verdict starts complete_; verdict_class is exactly positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only unfinished owned work that another attempt can finish is partial.
gate_check_summary: principle: Every blocked_* or complete_blocked_* outcome names check, upstream, path/hash, field, operator, expected and observed; missing is distinct from zero.
inference_substrate, inference_substrate_class, MODEL_SPECS, model_invocation_counts, historical_model_provenance: principle: Record actual calls and separate imported evidence from current generation.
rows, intended_count, completed_count, failed_count, censored_count, excluded_count, independent_count, sample_size_budget: principle: Each intended question, arm, seed, episode or repeat retains its own metric or missing reason; siblings and deterministic repeats do not multiply independence.
verifier_is_oracle, exposure_scope, independent_generalization_score, generalized_learning_benefit_score: principle: Oracle fixtures and exposed-history positives are circular_positive, with generalization scores zero.
required_checks_passed, flagged_adversarial, acceptance_gates, validation_receipts, terminal_validation_sidecar_path, adversarial_findings: principle: Qualification is distinct from benefit; failed required checks forbid positive classes.
preconditions_checked, duration_s, phase_spans, random_seed, reproducibility_checksum, source_artifact_hashes, code_config_hashes, raw_shard_hashes: principle: Preserve real measured work and immutable primitive operands.
cited_upstream_artifacts, field_principles: principle: Explain each additional metric and acceptance gate and identify original producer hashes.
objective_stream_ready_score, stream_rows_reference, retention_rows, trajectory_manifest, applied_update_events, physical_coordinate_writes, changed_coordinate_count, unique_changed_coordinates, decay_scale_changes, effective_coefficient_changes, admission_rows, release_rows, restart_rows, update_cost_s, hardware_path: principle: Causal later predictions and independently measured update activity are different outcomes.
